summary: Comprehensive testing of EduOS 2026 P0/P1 features completed. All major features are working: Student/Teacher/Parent login, Settings page, Virtual Classroom, Study Groups, Course View with 5 learning modes. Fixed sidebar navigation bug for parent portal.
passed_tests: Backend: Health endpoint (200 OK)
Backend: Student login (demo.student@eduos.edu) - returns access_token
Backend: Teacher login (demo.teacher@eduos.edu) - returns access_token
Backend: Parent login (demo.parent@eduos.edu) - returns access_token
Backend: GET /api/dashboard/stats - returns dashboard statistics
Backend: GET /api/courses - returns courses list
Backend: GET /api/user/settings - returns user settings
Backend: PUT /api/user/profile - updates user profile
Backend: PUT /api/user/notifications - updates notification settings
Backend: PUT /api/user/password - changes password
Backend: GET /api/zoom/student-meetings - returns meetings for students
Backend: GET /api/zoom/meetings - returns meetings for teachers
Backend: GET /api/study-groups/all - returns all public study groups
Backend: GET /api/study-groups/my-groups - returns user's study groups
Backend: GET /api/parents/children - returns linked children for parent
Backend: GET /api/courses/{id} - returns single course
Backend: GET /api/content/course/{id}/content - returns course content
Backend: Invalid credentials correctly rejected (401)
Frontend: Student login and dashboard display
Frontend: Teacher login and dashboard display
Frontend: Parent login and dashboard display
Frontend: Settings page - Profile Information section
Frontend: Settings page - Notification Preferences section
Frontend: Settings page - Security section with password change
Frontend: Virtual Classroom page - Zoom (Active) and Google Meet (Pending)
Frontend: Study Groups page - My Study Groups and AI-Suggested Groups
Frontend: Study Groups page - Find Matches button
Frontend: Parent Portal - Shows linked child with GPA, attendance, courses
Frontend: Course View page - 5 learning modes (Text, Video, Audio, Slides, Avatar Tutor)
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Parent sidebar navigation - changed /children to /parent-portal for 'My Children' link

mocked_apis.note: Payment System uses WhatsApp wa.me link. Blockchain Credentials use hash-based verification.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0/P1 features verified working: 1) Student/Teacher/Parent login with dashboard display. 2) Settings page with profile update, notification settings, and password change. 3) Virtual Classroom shows Zoom (Active) and Google Meet (Pending). 4) Study Groups with AI matching. 5) Parent Portal shows linked children with academic progress. 6) Course View page has 5 learning modes. Fixed parent sidebar navigation bug.

settings_page: Profile Information section with name, email, phone, role
course_view: 5 learning modes (Text, Video, Audio, Slides, Avatar Tutor)
